title: Karna rules pack
description: A JSON array of Karna rules. This is the shape of a global rules pack file (a `.json` file under KARNA_GLOBAL_RULES_PATH) and of the `json` field published to the Redis hash `karna:global_rules`. Rule ids must be unique across the pack: duplicates are first-wins, disk before Redis, and the discarded copy is logged. Reference: https://karna.sicuranext.com/docs/rules.html#global-rules
